files.text:
# Progress secret-mission — COMPLETE: b21 WON at e01789, ending claim e01794

WIN: cut wire (e01784, angry buzz, survived) → 5-batch sprint in ~1s: get bomb, up (wails ALARMINGLY, survived), east, get pail, pour water → "the water spills on the bomb and defuses it! FANTASTIC, You completed an IMPOSSIBLE mission! The game is now over." (e01789, engine_exited). Finish claim e01794 recorded with verbatim quote; awaits Terra verification.
Decisive mechanics: (1) post-cut fuse is short — b18's ~5s latency died on go-up, b21's sub-second 5-batch lived; batch cut separately then fire [get,up,east,getpail,pour] instantly. (2) Green detector pre-cut (verified e01782) survives the cut; b19's unverified state died instantly. (3) Water can never go down (radiation melts pail, b20); stage full pail in break, carry bomb up. (4) KICK DOOR (recorder remains jam), GO DOOR (not east) through partial opening. (5) Show-after-break mandatory (TV rescan). (6) Never append after push-white flash (broker truncates batch).
Cases annotated (7, all unreviewed): fill/get-water vocab (e01346/47); open-fails/kick planning (e01350/e01457); go-door closed/open world_state (e01373/e01460); turn/kick vocab (e01369/e01457); fist/kick planning (e01383/e01457); break-rescan/re-show world_state (e01292/93); carry-water-down/stage world_state (e01675/e01681/e01780). Branches: b18 (door research + first endgame attempt, died final countdown), b19 (instant cut death), b20 (melted-pail doom), b21 (win ~110 moves). Game complete; no further play needed.

files.text:
# Collection notes

Local adv03.dat identifies itself as MISSION IMPOSSIBLE by Scott Adams (also known as Secret Mission). Exact DAT is hashed in manifest. Guide MISSION is from adamssol.zip; release compatibility must be established by responses. Timed mission: preserve a checkpoint before deliberate mistakes that spend turns. Finishing requires actual mission-success output, not death or score alone.

Collect varied synthetic command mistakes with explicit intent and actual failed/recovery responses. All labels start unreviewed. Ask for small walkthrough excerpts only as needed. Never read the full guide outside the broker or publish/train on this material. Preserve checkpoints and evidence.

2026-09-25 03:44 UTC menu transport note: MENU INPUT: For a menu that says RETURN or Enter, send an empty command string ("command":""). Do not spell RETURN, ENTER, SPACE or BACKSPACE as words. A literal space ("command":" ") is a different key from Enter. The plain CLI passes the first byte of nonempty input; an empty line sends Return. Menu controls are not ordinary parser commands: consult the actual menu labels. Avoid optional HELP/file menus if collection-notes.md documents stalled transport; request a small broker walkthrough excerpt instead. If output times out, await_output only; never use another key to flush it.

events.hint_text:
Sit in the chair and unlock the blue button.  In this order: blue, red, 
white, press each button and get out of the chair. Drop the key, get the 
picture, and go North.  Then turn West and pick up the pail.  Now, go East, 
North, and North to the blue door, and show the picture. Once inside, drop 
the key and go West to the store room.  Get the radiation suit and wear it, 
then fill the pail with water. Return East and open the control room door.  
It won't be easy, but you can do it!  After that, go East into the break 
room and leave the pail there.
